title: Objects ZIA and Cloud & Branch Connector share: IP groups and network services
aliases: ip source groups shared with zia
objects created in zia appear in cloud connector

prose.text: Some Cloud & Branch Connector objects are not separate from ZIA's. {{creator-context}} {{zia-created-listed}}

prose.label: Which pairs.
prose.text: The marker sits on the four kinds that have a ZIA counterpart of the same name, plus IP pool groups, which have none: {{twin-types}} Whether a pair is one record seen from both products, so that an edit or delete in one shows in the other, is open {{gap:same-record}}. Writing a ZIA-origin group through the Cloud Connector API is in [[cloud-connector.source-ip-groups:zia-origin-editability]].

prose.label: Pairs without the marker.
prose.text: Locations and workload groups also exist in both products under the same names, but nothing public marks them as shared {{gap:unmarked-twins}}.

creator-context.statement: The Cloud & Branch Connector API gives source IP groups, destination IP groups, IP pool groups, network services and network service groups a `creatorContext` of ZIA or EC: the product the object was created in.

zia-created-listed.statement: So the Cloud & Branch Connector lists of those objects can hold objects created in ZIA, not only its own.
zia-created-listed.conditions: A ZIA value in creatorContext is meaningful only for an object created in ZIA that the Cloud & Branch Connector API returns; no source states the sync directly.

twin-types.statement: Source IP groups, destination IP groups, network services and network service groups are object types of both the ZIA and the Cloud & Branch Connector APIs.
twin-types.conditions: Read from the zscalerctl catalogue, which has both types of each name, and the creatorContext marker; the field-for-field match of each pair is not checked.

same-record.title: Whether a shared pair is one record in both products
same-record.detail: Whether a ZIA-created group has the same ID in both APIs, and whether an edit or delete in one product shows in the other, is not stated by any captured source.

unmarked-twins.title: Whether locations and workload groups are shared between ZIA and Cloud & Branch Connector
unmarked-twins.detail: Both products have locations and workload groups, and the Cloud & Branch Connector contract gives them no creatorContext; whether an object created in one appears in the other is not stated by any captured source.
